problem: An asynchronous B3 qualification can finish or fail before any model process or BeforeResume. Existing runHarness sends Wait errors/incomplete results to UNKNOWN, and its known result path requires dispatch.identity equal to a nonzero model process tuple. observeRuntime independently forbids empty identity; finishHarness reports native Codex process completion and creates a codex-result projection. Zero PID maps or qualification PIDs cannot satisfy those semantics truthfully.

producer_boundary: Recognize only the concrete private qualifiedHandle, not an arbitrary public interface, result State string, JSON or persisted marker.
Require its done channel closed and stable terminal state under its mutex; copy value-only sanitized facts.

Set delegateAttempted before invoking B1 rpc.Start. Once attempted, even if Start returns an error and delegate remains nil, this accessor returns false. Absence of a delegate or model PID alone proves nothing.

Known-no-qualification-child must be an explicit internal lifecycle fact; otherwise require every original qualification child/Job stopped, streams drained and cleanup complete. A zero-valued capture is not proof.

Bind facts to exact Task/Run/epoch/source binding hash/requested template/native/helper/Host boot identity and bounded failure reason. Keep qualification process identity and stop evidence in a separately named preparation field.
The accessor proves a failed consumed preparation only; it cannot qualify a model or recreate a B1 permit. Keep CodexResult.Identity empty and never copy qualification PID into it.
After delegation, cancellation must wait for owned cleanup rather than prematurely return from delegate.Wait(child). Uncertain delegated outcome remains UNKNOWN through the existing result path.
recommended_api.shared_dto: No codex.go or public rev2 DTO extension is necessary. Export only the narrow value projection and concrete-handle accessor from the B3 implementation; no public JSON/HTTP producer.

domain_design.wait_branch: After handle.Wait and stopping/joining the pulse goroutine, but before existing waitErr/identity checks, call the concrete accessor. Only a matching known preparation failure enters the new private helper. Other Start errors, incomplete stop proof, delegated Start attempts or mismatches retain existing harnessUnknown.
transaction_conditions: resourceWriteLock; exact project/Task/Run/current epoch and active_run ownership; exact captured dispatch key, manifest hash, STARTED state, worker and journal locator; persisted model identity must remain {}.

Preparation facts must match captured launch/source/policy identity. No BeforeResume or BeforeModelTurn/model authorization has occurred. Reject ambiguous state; do not infer this from missing files alone.
Require clientQueueSettled rather than inventing queue_empty. Recheck only terminal ownership/provenance, not a new execution grant; revocation must not stop recording a safely stopped failure.

For a minimal first revision, CANCEL_REQUESTED, epoch/worker change or conflicting terminal facts conservatively use UNKNOWN unless a separately reviewed preparation-cancellation terminal branch supplies its own exact proof.

Atomically store a sanitized Host LOG with schema researchos.native-preparation-outcome.v1, phase PREPARATION_FAILED, qualifier evidence references and model_start_delegated=false; retain qualification identities separately.

Keep dispatch STARTED, original worker/locator/identity {}, observation_sequence/hash unchanged, and set bounded preparation-failure reason. Never reset PREPARED, replace identity, create a model observation or set state OBSERVED.

Mark the existing Run FAILED with truthful preparation execution_report, ended_at and empty result_artifact_ids; leave exit_code/model external identity null. Do not create researchos.codex-result.v1 or empty assistant results. Preserve original Task/Run identifiers and existing failure counters; use established task-terminal persistence/event helpers with a preparation-specific failure reason, not a fake reportRun receipt.

Emit the existing TASK_TERMINAL in the same transaction and project public FAILED/result=null. Preserve public schema and error-code set; existing HARNESS_UNAVAILABLE can carry a sanitized preparation-failure message. PREPARATION_FAILED is a private phase, not a new public or dispatch enum.

Duplicate identical durable failure is idempotent; conflicting facts fail. Any LOG/Run/Task/event/commit failure rolls back and falls back to UNKNOWN where persistable. A crash without committed proof stays UNKNOWN and cannot relaunch.
do_not_relax: finishHarness model completion wording and normal path
runtime_dispatches CHECK enum or immutable manifest trigger
B1 live permit or B3 qualification boundary
domain_design.budget_note: Do not fabricate native observations to satisfy releaseCompletedRuntimeLocalLaunch, which explicitly requires nativeDispatchProof and nonempty process identity. Retain any existing reservation pending a separately scoped preparation-settlement rule; do not synthesize provider cost/zero inference or reuse resource_effects. This minimal design adds no ledger semantics.

root_serial_after_B1_B3_freeze: internal/domain/runtime_harness_windows.go (small Wait branch and truthful existing failure message)

required_future_counterexamples: Known failed qualification with actual stopped qualifier identity but no model identity yields FAILED/result=null, consumed STARTED dispatch and one terminal event.
Explicit no-child preparation failure is accepted; empty capture without lifecycle proof is UNKNOWN.
A fake handle or serialized projection cannot mint known preparation failure.
delegateAttempted then B1.Start error never qualifies as pre-model no-launch failure.
Incomplete stop/drain, cancellation uncertainty, changed epoch/worker, nonempty model identity, or any model authorization yields UNKNOWN.
DB/event failure commits neither partial FAILED nor fake model evidence; subsequent Scan does not relaunch.
Qualification PID stays separate; no model result/exit0/native completion report is fabricated.
Normal B1 model-process completion path remains unchanged.
pending_blockers: Root must register exact serial source lease after current B1/B3 freezes.
Review actual implementation and controlled fixtures before approval; no tests or actual Native/model execution are authorized by this design.
